name: Signature and Company Stamp
html:
{# Two signatures and a circle for the stamp. _("…") prints a text in the language of the print. #}
{{ _("Finance Manager") }}{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}
{{ _("Company stamp") }}
{{ _("General Manager") }}{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

name: Authorized Signatory
html:
{# One signature at the end of the line, with the name of who prints and the date. #}
{{ _("Authorized Signatory") }}
{{ printed_by }}
{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(printed_on) }}

name: Balance Confirmation
html:
{# A statement sent to a customer or a supplier: their confirmation and the company's signature. #}

{{ _("We confirm that the balance shown in this statement is correct as on {0}.")|replace("{0}", frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.to_date or doc.report_date or printed_on)) }}

{{ _("For the customer / supplier") }}{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}:{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}:{{ _("Stamp") }}:
{{ _("For {0}")|replace("{0}", doc.company) if doc.company else _("For the company") }}{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}:{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}:{{ _("Stamp") }}:

name: Signature Grid
Issued by and Received by
html:
{# A document's signature. In a print format of your own: {{ report_view_signature("Issued by and Received by", doc) }} #} {% set day = doc.posting_date or doc.transaction_date or doc.creation %}
{{ _("Issued by") }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}{{ frappe.get_fullname(doc.owner) }}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Date") }}{{ frappe.utils.format_date(day) if day else "" }}

{{ _("Received by") }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Date") }}

name: Approval Steps
html:
{# Three steps, numbered: who prepared the document (filled), who reviews and who approves it. #}
{% for label, who in [(_("Prepared by"), frappe.get_fullname(doc.owner)), (_("Reviewed by"), ""), (_("Approved by"), "")] %}
{{ loop.index }}{{ label }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}{% if who %}{{ who }}{% else %}{% endif %}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Date") }}

{% endfor %}

name: Accountant, Manager and Stamp
html:
{# Two signatures and the place of the company's stamp, with its name. #}
{{ _("Accountant", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}{{ frappe.get_fullname(doc.owner) }}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Finance Manager") }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Company stamp") }}{% if company %}{{ company }}{% endif %}

name: Receipt Acknowledgement
html:
{# One framed statement the receiver signs: name, signature, date in a row. #}

{{ _("I acknowledge that I have received the above in full and in good order.") }}

{{ _("Name", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Signature", context="Report View") }}

{{ _("Date") }}
